record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: For a vertex operator algebra V associated to a Wess-Zumino-Witten model, a minimal model, a lattice vertex operator algebra, or the moonshine module vertex operator algebra, does the nth cohomology of V, viewed as a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra with coefficients in any V-bimodule, vanish for every positive integer n?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.2. Let V be a vertex operator algebra associated to a Wess-Zumino-Witten model, a minimal model, a lattice vertex operator algebra or the moonshine module vertex operator algebra. Then for n in Z+, the n-th cohomology of V as a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra with coefficients in any V-bimodule is 0.

artifact.status_search_result: The cohomology theory of meromorphic open-string vertex algebras with coefficients in bimodules is the subject of an active research program by Huang, Qi, and collaborators. Partial results connect vanishing of the first cohomology to reductivity and to classification of extensions, but no published work establishes the full vanishing of H^n(V,W) for all positive n and all bimodules W for the listed classes (WZW, minimal models, lattice VOAs, moonshine module). The conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The first cohomology, derivations and the reductivity of a (meromorphic open-string) vertex algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Proves that vanishing of the first cohomology for every bimodule implies complete reducibility of certain modules.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial (first-cohomology) results connecting vanishing to reductivity have been obtained; higher-degree vanishing for the listed VOAs is not established.

status_evidence.title: On the extensions of the left modules for a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra, I
status_evidence.snippet: Studies first cohomology and extensions for MOSVAs; ongoing program.
status_evidence.claim: Research on this cohomology theory remains active without resolving the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Representation theory and cohomology theory of meromorphic open-string vertex algebras (thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the cohomology theory of MOSVAs.
status_evidence.claim: The general vanishing conjecture for WZW, minimal model, lattice and moonshine VOAs is not proved in this framework.
